info.description:
A comprehensive REST API built with Go and Gin framework
This API provides user authentication, profile management, and admin operations.

get.description: Handle Facebook OAuth callback. After authenticating with Facebook, you'll be redirected here with a code and state parameter. This endpoint exchanges the code for tokens and returns JWT tokens for your application.

parameters.description: Authorization code from Facebook (obtained after user authentication)
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: State parameter for CSRF protection (generated during login)
parameters.name: state

200.description: Login successful - JWT tokens and user info returned

400.description: Bad request - missing code or state parameter

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid state or authentication failed

get.description: Generate Facebook OAuth authorization URL. Copy the URL, open it in your browser, authenticate with Facebook, and you'll be redirected back with a code and state parameter.
